description: T-3348 review round 1: Gate A fresh sweep for RATE after the model was frozen (decision 0188 R2, R4.2; reviewer check 7). Generated after commit cf5359b54 and never used to build or tune the model; the older t3348-rate-gate-a-sweep is training evidence. 300 ordinary annuities with fv != 0 and one root in (-1, inf), guess omitted, type 0/1, every input log-uniform over the domain (rate 1E-6 to 1, nper 1 to 1000, |pv| and |fv| 1 to 1E12), stratified 6 x 50 by rate band (1E-6 to 1E-4, 1E-4 to 1E-2, 1E-2 to 1) and balance scale (1 to 1E6, 1E6 to 1E12). Fixed seed T-3348/RATE/r4-fresh-after-freeze. pmt is the payment of the drawn rate cut to 15 digits; each label ends in math=, the 50-digit mpmath root of the cell's literal inputs (dps 60 checked at dps 80), until SPEC-0029's math sidecars land.
